objective: Replace Alpine Loop with the smallest trustworthy app that finds useful constraint-based loop hikes, proven on real Washington data.

baseline.method: Physical lines in first-party tracked .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.py/.sh/.css files; exclude public vendored assets, .agents, .test/.spec files, tests/, testing/, __fixtures__/, and test-helpers.ts. Include application, preparation, research, scripts, and root code configuration. Normal readable formatting required.

experience: all meaningfully different routes available through paging; no per-start result cap
adjustable maximum road distance and share; trails remain the main experience
setup: no user source processing or API keys
quality: 20 frozen real queries across 3 contrasting Washington areas

performance.priority: User clarified 2026-09-30: longer searches are acceptable. Timing is descriptive; do not complicate architecture or cut exploration to chase sub-10-second results.

acceptance.engineering: Challenge raw sources, processing and storage from first principles. Prioritize robust code over patchwork tests; use targeted independent checks with restraint.
deferred: Hosted URL: user explicitly deferred hosting on 2026-09-30 to focus on an excellent local app that can be hosted later.

state: The local desktop app supports exact map-area selection, adjustable road miles/share, progressive grouped choices, direction-specific inspection/GPX and browser reconnect. No route option is discarded by similarity grouping; full reversed walks share an option only when both directions qualify independently. Maintained app plus preparation/tooling is 5,007 lines versus 24,063 at baseline. Current search options now use a disposable SQLite file via Node builtin; the worker keeps representative footprints instead of an all-option identity map. A frozen pre-lifecycle/canonicalization storage build retained 133,411 Paradise-day options after 10 minutes at 277 MB peak RSS, with Stop 19 ms, reconnect intact and no guard/error. At 5 minutes it had 62,085 options versus baseline 67,195 / 914 MB; timing/machine pressure uncontrolled. One disk sample 608 MB at 412 seconds is not peak disk use. This does not bound arbitrary-duration RAM/disk or prove completion. Final integrated server is live on 3011; the stopped Rainier search's full pages were preserved locally, its unchanged query replayed and stopped after 30 seconds for review: 292 groups / 4,112 options, 476 starts attempted / 162 fully explored, with incomplete coverage disclosed. Browser reload and road-setting restoration passed. Corrected f349 snapshot remains installed: 222,175 sections / 11,649 starts / 73.86 MB runtime files.
